about:
Seaboard Controls was founded in 1981 in Crosby, Texas, by Philip Muro, a U.S. Marine veteran who applied the discipline and code of ethics from his military service to the business. The company remains under his leadership and operates as a veteran-owned enterprise.

The firm provides engineering, design, fabrication, and field services for electrical power and control systems. Its in-house capabilities include low- and medium-voltage switchboard design and manufacturing, custom control panel fabrication, motor rewinding and overhaul, PLC and HMI programming, SCADA systems, and custom enclosure production such as blast-resistant buildings, remote instrument enclosures, fiberglass structures, and pressurized buildings. The facility is UL 508, UL 891, and ISO 9001 compliant and supports turnkey projects as well as à la carte services.

Seaboard serves marine, industrial, oil and gas, and data center sectors. Marine clients receive shore power systems and classification-approved equipment meeting ABS, USCG, and DNV standards. Industrial and oil-and-gas customers use custom drive packages, protective relay programming, water treatment controls, and electrical equipment centers. Data center projects include custom enclosures and power management systems.

The company emphasizes “flawless execution, on time, every time” and positions its after-sales service as equal in importance to pre-sales support. Its quality pledge commits to aggressive quality attitudes, continuous improvement, and compliance with a broad range of standards including NEMA, NEC, IEEE, MSHA, and IEC.
